name: Sky & Oath
text: Zeus watches over oaths, law and order. The Court gains Favor steadily.

name: Counsel & the Defended City
text: Athena defends towns. Olympian shrines start with +1 Ward.

name: Grain & Bread
text: Followers on grassland and plains give extra Faith.

name: Sea & Shaking Earth
text: Olympian priests may cross shallow sea; coastal settlements feel stronger Olympian pressure.

name: Runes & Poetry
text: Each word leads to another word. Winning followers from rivals earns Favor (1 per 4).

name: Peace, Rain & Sunshine
text: Settlements you control grow by 1 extra every 4 turns.

name: The Woven Fate
text: Every resolved event card grants +1 Favor.

name: The Sun's Course
text: Followers on desert and plains give extra Faith.

name: Order against Disorder
text: Your followers are harder to convert (rivals need 50% more effort).

name: Reckoning & Writing
text: Read Omens costs half and reveals 1 hex further.

name: The Inundation
text: Followers in settlements beside water give extra Faith.
